description: This Java class 'EcuDefinitionDocumentLoader' provides functionality to parse an ECU definition XML file into a DOM Document object. It contains a method to load and parse the XML file specified within an EcuDefinition object, handling exceptions related to parser configuration, SAX errors, and IO errors.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionDocumentLoader
classes.description: Provides static methods to load and parse ECU definition XML files into DOM documents.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Parses the XML ECU definition file specified by the EcuDefinition object into a DOM Document. Handles parser configuration, SAX, and IO exceptions.
